patterns: APPSC asks direct single-fact items: who said a quote (Ambedkar 'progress of a community', Nehru 'condition of a nation'), who coined 'missing women', first women's court state.
Reformer-contribution statement questions (Vidyasagar: widow remarriage, not Sambad Kaumudi) - trap is attributing another reformer's work.
'Which was NOT proposed/NOT correct' items on recent bills (Surrogacy Bill 2019) and year-matching of Acts (1986 Indecent Rep. vs 1987 Sati).
Other PSCs test UN milestones (1975 Women's Year, Beijing 1995) and the triple-talaq timeline (Allahabad HC, Shayara Bano 2017).
App MCQs are far more numerous and lean to multi-statement/match/assertion formats and 2026 current-affairs detail; PYQs are mostly one-liners with an AP scheme tilt.
